system.description:
Once per round, call your shot before you swing. Roll a d4 alongside your attack; if the hit lands and the d4 comes up 3 or better, choose one: knock the target Prone, disarm it, push it 10ft, blind it until the end of its next turn, or give it Disadvantage on its next attack. The target resists with a save against 10 + half your level (minimum 1) + your Strength modifier: Fortitude against Prone, a push or a disarm, Reflex against blinding, Will against the attack penalty. A creature that saves is immune to your Deeds for the rest of the fight. A creature more than one size larger than you ignores the deed.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.

activities.name: Deed die (1d4)
activities.text: Roll alongside your attack: on a hit with 3 or better, choose a deed.

activities.name: Prone, push or disarm
activities.text: Knock it Prone, push it 10ft or disarm it, unless it saves. A creature that saves is immune to your Deeds for the rest of the fight; one more than a size larger than you ignores them.

activities.name: Blind
activities.text: Blind it until the end of its next turn, unless it saves. A creature that saves is immune to your Deeds for the rest of the fight; one more than a size larger than you ignores them.

activities.name: Attack penalty
activities.text: Disadvantage on its next attack, unless it saves. A creature that saves is immune to your Deeds for the rest of the fight; one more than a size larger than you ignores them.
